workload.affinity: thread-count-only; operating-system scheduled for both engines
workload.warmup: one discarded engine-native warmup before each measured test
workload.thread_policy: per host_profile; identical for both engines within a run

apple_m1max.note: 8 performance cores; decode leaves one core to the OS

amd_9950x.note: 16 physical cores, SMT siblings excluded; same core-minus-one rule as apple_m1max. Rule-based, not tuned per engine — a matched thread count is the fairness claim, not an optimum.
